name: NWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The National Wrestling League's own top championship, held by an early signing turned in-fiction front-office boss for as long as this corpus's own record runs.

name: NWL International Championship
notes: The fed's own roster document names its holder as of 13 May 2004; no reign start or end date survives in the held record.
epitaph: A championship the National Wrestling League's own roster document confirms was live and defended during the fed's active months.

name: NWL Television Championship
epitaph: The National Wrestling League's own secondary championship, worn openly by its holder in a served title-defense promo naming the belt by name.
